verses.text: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus.
They saw some of his followers eating food with hands that were "unclean", which means they had not washed them.
The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands in a special way. They do this to keep the old rules handed down by their leaders.
When they come from the market, they do not eat unless they wash first. And they keep many other rules too, such as washing cups, jugs, copper pots and couches.
So the Pharisees and the teachers of the law asked Jesus, "Why do your followers not live by the rules handed down by our leaders? Why do they eat their food with unclean hands?"
He answered them, "Isaiah was right when he spoke about you hypocrites. He wrote, 'These people honour me with their lips, but their hearts are far away from me.
Their worship of me is worthless. Their teachings are only rules made up by people.'
You have let go of the commands of God, and you are holding on to rules made up by people. You wash jugs and cups, and you do many other things like that."
He said to them, "You are very good at setting aside the commands of God so that you can keep your own rules!
For Moses said, 'Honour your father and your mother.' He also said, 'Anyone who curses their father or mother must be put to death.'
But you say that a man can tell his father or mother, 'Whatever help you might have received from me is Corban.'" Corban means a gift set apart for God.
"Then you no longer let him do anything for his father or mother.
In this way you cancel the word of God by your own rules that you hand down. And you do many other things like that."
Again Jesus called the crowd to him. He said, "Listen to me, all of you, and understand this.
Nothing that goes into a person from the outside can make them unclean. It is what comes out of a person that makes them unclean.
Whoever has ears should listen."
Then he left the crowd and went into a house. His followers asked him about this saying.
"Do you not understand either?" he asked. "Do you not see that nothing going into a person from the outside can make them unclean?
It does not go into their heart. It goes into their stomach and then out of their body." When Jesus said this, he was showing that all foods are clean.
He went on, "What comes out of a person is what makes them unclean.
Evil thoughts come from the inside, from a person's heart. So do sexual sins, stealing, murder,
adultery, greed, evil acts, lying, wild living, jealousy, insulting others, pride and foolishness.
All these evil things come from the inside, and they make a person unclean."
Jesus left that place and went to the area of Tyre and Sidon. He went into a house and did not want anyone to know he was there. But he could not keep it a secret.
Soon a woman heard about him. Her little daughter had an evil spirit. She came and fell at his feet.
The woman was not Jewish. She was born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
Jesus said to her, "First let the children eat all they want. It is not right to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs."
"Yes, Lord," she replied. "But even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs."
Then he told her, "Because you said this, you may go home. The demon has left your daughter."
So she went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone.
Then Jesus left the area of Tyre and went through Sidon. He went down to the Sea of Galilee and into the area of the Ten Towns.
There some people brought a man to him who was deaf and could hardly talk. They begged Jesus to put his hand on the man.
Jesus took him away from the crowd, to be alone with him. He put his fingers into the man's ears. Then he spat and touched the man's tongue.
He looked up to heaven and took a deep breath. He said to the man, "Ephphatha!" This means, "Be opened!"
Straight away the man's ears were opened, his tongue was set free, and he began to speak clearly.
Jesus ordered the people not to tell anyone. But the more he told them not to, the more they kept talking about it.
People were completely amazed. "He has done everything well," they said. "He even makes deaf people hear, and people who cannot speak talk!"
